title: Minimum Rounds to Complete All Tasks
summary: Given an array of task difficulties, determine the minimum rounds needed to complete all tasks by doing either two or three tasks of the same difficulty per round.
statement: Given an array of task difficulties, determine the minimum rounds needed to complete all tasks by doing either two or three tasks of the same difficulty per round. Return -1 if completion is impossible.
constraints: Each round completes exactly two or exactly three tasks of one difficulty.
All tasks must be completed; tasks of different difficulties cannot share a round.
Return -1 if any difficulty occurs only once.
reference_solution:
def minimum_task_rounds(tasks):
    from collections import Counter
    answer=0
    for count in Counter(tasks).values():
        if count==1:return -1
        answer+=(count+2)//3
    return answer

def minimum_task_rounds(tasks):
    from collections import Counter
    answer=0
    for count in Counter(tasks).values():
        if count<3:return -1
        answer+=(count+2)//3
    return answer
hints: Each difficulty count can be handled independently.
Use as many groups of three as possible, replacing a remainder one with two groups of two.
If count is one return -1; otherwise add ceil(count/3), written (count+2)//3.
For every count at least two, ceil(count/3) groups suffice using twos and threes and fewer groups cannot cover all tasks.
